items.title: Cybersecurity News Weekly Newsletter – 29.7 Tbps DDoS Attack, Chrome 143, React2Shell Vulnerabilities, and Cloudflare Outage
items.description: This week’s cybersecurity landscape featured a record-breaking 29.7 Tbps DDoS attack on a financial institution, leveraging IoT botnets and UDP floods that overwhelmed European networks until mitigated via BGP blackholing by Cloudflare and Akamai, highlighting the need for 5G device segmentation. Google released Chrome 143, patching 12 high-severity flaws, including three actively exploited…

items.title: LockBit 5.0 Infrastructure Exposed in New Server, IP and  Domain Leak
items.description: LockBit 5.0 key infrastructure exposed, revealing the IP address 205.185.116.233, and the domain karma0.xyz is hosting the ransomware group’s latest leak site. items.title: Hackers Launch Widespread Attacks on Palo Alto GlobalProtect Portals from 7,000+ IPs
items.description: In an escalating campaign targeting remote access infrastructure, threat actors have initiated active exploitation attempts against Palo Alto Networks’ GlobalProtect VPN portals. GrayNoise tracking activity report scans and exploitation efforts originating from more than 7,000 unique IP addresses worldwide, raising alarms for organizations relying on the popular VPN solution for secure remote…
